subject: significant events during the reporting period

finding: The publication is an IFRS quarterly report, but the disclosed cost-to-income ratio is explicitly 'under PRC GAAP'. Accounting basis cannot be inherited blindly from the document manifest; observations need local basis overrides.

The same report gives Group net profit RMB75,580m and net profit attributable to equity holders of the Bank RMB75,185m. They are different constructs and must not be deduplicated merely because both are 'net profit'.

Headline total loans and advances to customers is RMB28,482,604m, while the disclosed business-type components are explicitly 'excluding accrued interest' and sum to RMB28,424,118m, leaving RMB58,486m. Likewise, total customer deposits are RMB34,517,455m while business-line components excluding accrued interest sum to RMB34,076,038m, leaving RMB441,417m. These residuals are expected from differing source grains/bases and must not be treated as extraction errors or silently forced to reconcile.

Coverage therefore needs both document-block status and profile identity; a single boolean extraction_complete is too weak.
